question: Should the Control UI add a per-message Markdown/plain-text copy menu, and which conversion semantics should plain-text output use for code, lists, tables, links, and images?
rationale: The feature is technically bounded, but source inspection cannot determine the desired interaction or clipboard representation contract; those choices affect visible Control UI behavior and future consistency.

options.title: Add Per-Message Menu
options.body: Expose Markdown and plain-text choices beside each assistant message and define a focused semantic conversion contract with browser clipboard tests.

options.title: Keep Markdown Only
options.body: Retain the current single copy action to avoid another control and conversion contract in the chat bubble.

options.title: Add Persisted Preference
options.body: Store a default copy format in UI settings, accepting the extra settings and upgrade surface instead of prompting per copy.

recommendation.title: Add Per-Message Menu
recommendation.body: Expose Markdown and plain-text choices beside each assistant message and define a focused semantic conversion contract with browser clipboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior originates in their Control UI copy implementation, and the unresolved choice is primarily a product interaction decision.
